name: Durable
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+ You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

features.name: Speedy Recovery
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll.
